question: the 20->10 cadence gain was measured on books that all start in the 2020 winter; does it survive a start date in 2021, 2023, 2025?

rule.R1_starts: quarterly anchors 2020-06-01..2025-09-01; a start whose book is shorter than 300 bars is named in excluded_starts with the reason and never read as a zero
rule.R2_pair: every delta pairs the SAME start date, the same cost, the same n_hold and the same horizon -- only the cadence differs, so no other ruler is mixed in
rule.R3_sign: the direction holds iff at least 60% of start dates move the same way (threshold frozen before the first run)
rule.R4_calendar: the start-date term is the interquartile spread of the paired deltas; if it is at least as large as the median, the cadence gap lives inside the start-date noise
rule.R5_window: TO_CUTOFF anchors are nested (all books end at the same cutoff); the fixed 252/504-bar rulers slice each run's own head and are the ones allowed to speak about a single year of holding. A start too short for a horizon is a named hole for that horizon only
rule.R6_winter: the winter reading is read from etf_book_cadence_comparable (matched) and etf_book_rebal_adoption (paired run) and compared by a frozen band of [0.50, 2.00]x -- never recomputed here
rule.R7_money: money lines use a 1000000 reference account
rule.frozen: thresholds written before the first read of these panels in this round

rebal_adoption.note: control carries a vol target of 0.08; this face has none -- printed side by side, never merged

money.note: every delta already pays the faster cadence's own higher toll; the one-year line is the near-disjoint ruler, the to-cutoff line is the nested path

desk_sentence: 对票面：不改（节奏决定权在 etf_book_rebal_adoption）。「20→10 更快更好」在 21 个起跑日（2020-06..2025-09）上：跑到今天中位 -2.59 pp、36% 的起跑日为正（嵌套窗，一个尾巴算了好几遍）；切成一整年（252 bar，近互斥）中位 -0.04 pp、50% 为正。所以冬天以外这句话只剩一口气：起跑日四分位差 8.45 pp 比中位还大。
honest: survivorship: the on-disk panel holds ETFs that still exist (family caveat)
no vol target here: fast_next_open has none, so these are un-targeted books; the adoption face's vol-8% control is printed beside them and never merged
to-cutoff anchors are nested by construction: they share one tail, so their agreement/disagreement is a path, not independent evidence (R5)
fixed 252/504-bar rulers are near-disjoint only for anchors twelve months apart; quarterly neighbours still overlap inside a horizon
the earlier a book starts the more of 2020-2021 it contains, so for the earliest anchors 'start date' and 'which regime you lived through' are the same knob
